Elena / Kimberly,

Quick technical note on audit logs so expectations are aligned:

- Logs available: request logs, inference request headers (user-agent, client-ip masked), model inference trace (token-level metadata removed at export), authentication events, and KMS key rotation events. We cannot provide full prompt content for hosted customers; diagnostic traces will be redacted per PII policy.
- Export method: we can provide a time-bounded S3 export (parquet) + temporary read-only Athena/Kibana access. Typical prep time for a one-week window export is 3 business days once the window is selected.
- Retention: standard production retention is 90 days hot, 365 days cold. If Brightline requires different retention, we will need a ticket to legal/infra for contract & storage cost alignment.

Proposed deliverable for 2026-07-27 sample: S3 export URL + sample queries + a short runbook (attached link). I'll aim to have the runbook and sample queries by 2026-07-21.

Karthik Iyer
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example (audit-runbook)
